newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil coffee council to meet on Feb 4-grower.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee council to meet on Feb 4-grower.

text.p: A Brazilian coffee council joining the public and private sector will meet in Brasilia Feb 4 ahead of its official inaugural meeting on March 3, the vice-president of the National Coffee Council (CNC) said.
"There will be a meeting on Feb 4 in Brasilia," Luis Hafers told Reuters after a meeting of the CNC.
The government announced earlier this week that a meeting originally planned to take place in Vitoria on Feb 3 had been postponed until the following month.
The meeting in Brasilia would include both private and public sector representatives of the Conselho Deliberativo da Politica do Cafe (CDPC) or Deliberative Council for Coffee Policy, Hafers said.
Representatives were likely to talk about the possibility of the government raising its limit of 200,000 60-kg bags at its regular monthly stock auctions, he added.
The CNC earlier elected to keep its president on for another two-year term, a spokeswoman said.
Gilson Ximenes is to remain president of the CNC and Luis Hafers, Manoel Bertone and Dario Martinelli are set to continue as vice-presidents.
"There were no challenges and everything remains the same," the spokeswoman said.
